data.gender_notes: Hrithvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hrithvansh is derived from Sanskrit roots 'hrith' (God) and 'vansh' (lineage). It represents the divine descent or the divine lineage of an individual. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with gods and their dynasties. The name Hrithvansh carries the meaning “God's lineage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hrithvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's lineage and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hrithvansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hrithvansh carries a profound cultural significance as it is associated with ancient Hindu royalty and godly lineages. In Hindu mythology, the name is linked to dynasties of gods such as the Solar Dynasty (Suryavansh) and the Lunar Dynasty (Chandravansh). The name evokes a sense of nobility, power, and divine origin, reflecting the Hindu value of tracing one's roots and family tree back to the deities.
data.spiritual_significance: Hrithvansh also holds great spiritual significance, emphasizing one's connection to the divine and the belief in a divine lineage. The name symbolizes the innate belief that every individual comes from the divine realm and carries the divine essence within them. It serves as a reminder of the spiritual journey we all undertake in life, striving to embody the godly qualities within us and fulfilling our dharma (duty) towards ourselves, society, and the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Hrithvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Hrithu' (heart) and 'Vansh' (lineage or dynasty). It symbolizes a soul deeply rooted in the love and care of its ancestors, and a commitment to pass on this legacy to future generations.

historical_references.reference: The Haihayas were a powerful and prosperous dynasty of the Shaka-Satavahana period, ruling over the northern and central parts of India between 300 BCE and 230 CE. The name Hrithvansh is believed to be derived from Haihai, the dynasty's founder.

The epic Mahabharata describes the Kurukshetra war between the Pandavas and the Kauravas. One of the Pandava brothers, Bhima, was a member of the Hrithivasa clan. The Hrithivasa were a sub-branch of the Kuru dynasty and were known for their bravery and strength.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Hrithvansh' is derived from Hindu mythology, where it is the name of a king in the Mahabharata epic. Today, this name is seen on various social media platforms. On Instagram, it is used as a hashtag for posts related to Hindu culture, spirituality, and mythology. On Twitter, it is used in discussions and debates about Hinduism, Indian history, and spirituality. On YouTube, it is often found in the titles of videos related to Hindu rituals, stories, and teachings. The modern context of this name reflects a growing interest in Indian heritage and spirituality among people, particularly those of Indian descent or those who are interested in eastern philosophy and traditions.
